legacy_payload.visual_direction: flat design, no shadows or gradients, solid color blocks, simple icons, low-decoration, clean and modern, emphasis on color blocking and clarity

canvas.composition: grid of solid blocks, icon + text, balanced

color_palette.primary: white #FFFFFF / light ground #F5F7FA, one brand color #2563EB
color_palette.rule: flat, clean, 60-30-10 color rule; no gradients, no depth, no shadows

rendering_constraints: Flat color blocks + simple icons; obey 60-30-10.
No invented logos, no fake 3D or glossy effects.
